subject: Request: APAC Azure Marketplace prorated credits & VAT reallocation
messages:
From: Priya Suresh <priya@aroma-cloud.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: apac-marketplace-support@azure.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0800
Subject: Discrepancy: Oct prorated invoice + VAT allocation for APAC tenants

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. We dug into our October invoice and noticed a prorated charge that Azure applied to our listing after a mid-month SKU update. The invoice shows a $12,450 line that is labeled as "prorated usage adjustment," and VAT has been applied at the default seller rate, but our legal entity mapping (APAC reseller entity) should have the VAT applied differently per our marketplace agreement.

Can Redwood provide: 1) a breakdown of which tenant IDs from our marketplace listing generated that prorated line, and 2) your proposal for how to split the prorated credit between the two merchant entities we operate in APAC (Aroma Pte Ltd and Aroma India Pvt Ltd)? We're trying to assemble evidence for Azure to re-issue the invoice with corrected VAT lines.

I've attached our internal usage summary (aroma-usage-202610-azure-summary.csv) and a draft split we prepared. If you can confirm the tenant mapping and provide the proposed credit allocation file back to us, we'll submit it to Azure support (ticket 123456) and request a corrected invoice.

Appreciate a quick turnaround; our quarter-end close is next week.

Best,
Priya
Billing Ops | Aroma Cloud
attachments: aroma-usage-202610-azure-summary.csv, proposed-credit-split.xlsx

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Suresh <priya@aroma-cloud.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:05:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Oct prorated invoice + VAT allocation for APAC tenants

Priya,

Thanks for the packet and context — we reproduced the line on our side. Quick summary: the prorated $12,450 matches a mid-cycle SKU replacement that caused usage to be double-counted for the window 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-17 for three tenant IDs. We're confident the adjustment is valid, but the VAT tagging flowed to the wrong merchant entity in Azure's invoice.

Action items from Redwood (below) — we'll return an official allocation file and supporting evidence for Azure:  
- Jordan will extract the tenant -> reseller_entity mapping and produce a CSV (tenant_id, sku, usage_tokens, charge_usd).
- Karthik will run a short ledger proof that ties our ingest logs to the three tenant IDs and generate the KV timestamp bundle that Azure support prefers.
- I'll review and assemble the proposed credit split spreadsheet for your review.

We expect to have the files ready for you by EOD tomorrow (Thu Oct 8). I'll also attach a short note you can paste into the Azure ticket to speed up the reissue.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Revenue Ops Analyst | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference - Finance & Marketplaces

On Wed, 07 Oct 2026 at 09:12 AM Priya Suresh <priya@aroma-cloud.com> wrote:
> Hi Neha,
> 
> Thanks for taking the call earlier. We dug into our October invoice and noticed a prorated charge that Azure applied to our listing after a mid-month SKU update...

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, priya@aroma-cloud.com
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 15:18:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Oct prorated invoice + VAT allocation for APAC tenants

Neha / Priya —

Attached: "tenant-prorate-mapping.csv" (included in the evidence bundle) and a short ledger extract (ledger-snippet.txt) that shows the double-count period. TL;DR: the three tenant IDs are 10023, 10024, 10025; all three map to Aroma's two merchant entities as follows: 10023 -> Aroma Pte Ltd, 10024 -> Aroma India Pvt Ltd, 10025 -> Aroma India Pvt Ltd. The prorated USD breaks down as: 10023 = $3,900; 10024 = $4,200; 10025 = $4,350 (total $12,450).

I've also prepared a proposed-credit-split.xlsx with two proposals: (A) credit split by invoice tax jurisdiction (recommended for simplest tax repro), (B) credit apportioned to the tenant-level usage (preferred if Aroma needs ledger-level traceability). Proposal (A) routes 40% to Aroma Pte Ltd and 60% to Aroma India Pvt Ltd. Proposal (B) follows the per-tenant dollar amounts above.

Notes for Azure ticket:  
- This is a seller-side correction request; evidence bundle includes tenant-level usage and timestamped ingest logs.
- Requesting reissue with VAT reallocation to reflect merchant entity mapping (see attached proposed-credit-split.xlsx).

Marissa, can you confirm the VAT rate to use for Aroma India (we have a blended rate on file but want to be explicit before submission)?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Marketplaces Operations | Redwood Inference
attachments: tenant-prorate-mapping.csv, ledger-snippet.txt, proposed-credit-split.xlsx

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: priya@aroma-cloud.com, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: apac-marketplace-support@azure.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 14:05:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Oct prorated invoice + VAT allocation for APAC tenants

Hi Priya / team,

Confirmed — Aroma India should be charged VAT at 18% and Aroma Pte Ltd (Singapore) is non-VAT-registered for this SKU under the marketplace agreement. We approve Proposal (A) for the reissue (40% / 60%) so Azure can correct VAT lines without reprocessing tenant-level invoices. That will be faster for quarter close.

I've attached the Azure support PDF export (azure-ticket-123456.pdf) with our suggested ticket note filled in. Priya, please paste the following into ticket 123456 and ask Azure to re-issue the October invoice with the prorated credit split:  

--- suggested ticket body ---
Redwood Inference and Aroma Cloud request reissue of Oct 2026 Marketplace invoice (Invoice #AZ-2026-1007) to apply a prorated credit of $12,450 split 40% to Aroma Pte Ltd (non-VAT) and 60% to Aroma India Pvt Ltd (VAT 18%). Evidence bundle attached: tenant-prorate-mapping.csv, ledger-snippet.txt, proposed-credit-split.xlsx. Please update VAT breakdown lines and re-issue corrected invoice to Aroma's billing contact.

--- end suggested body ---

Let us know if you want Redwood to open the Azure ticket directly (we can attach the same evidence bundle and include our support contact).

Thanks and let's confirm once Azure issues the corrected invoice.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Cloud Billing Partnerships | Redwood Inference
attachments: azure-ticket-123456.pdf
